title: Reconciliation of F-WOF19 Owner-Host Gap with Existing Legacy Adapter Checkpoint
finding: The admitted lineage already contains a transactional B1.10 adapter checkpoint that captures and restores legacy crop globals, including emergence flags, DVS, LAI, root depth, WRT and additional WOFOST state. This does not constitute the explicit crop-owner state/interface that F-WOF19 requires for the new architecture.

scope_correction.too_broad_F_WOF19_phrase: current lineage has no crop lifecycle state binding
scope_correction.correct_interpretation: current lineage has no explicit new-architecture crop-owner lifecycle state authority/view binding; a legacy adapter checkpoint exists and keeps the admitted legacy backend transaction-safe
scope_correction.reason: F-WOF17/F-WOF18 must not depend on legacy globals or on the B1.10 adapter checkpoint representation. A compact crop-owned state carrier/view seam is still required.

architectural_consequence: do not delete or bypass the B1.10 crop checkpoint while the legacy backend depends on it
do not expose b1_10_crop_common_state_t as the new crop API
reuse the generic transaction_state_t/F-KT mechanism rather than implementing another transaction authority
introduce only the minimal common crop-owned state needed by the new root/ET path
